summary.text: Darisha Parker is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 198, which she has represented since December 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Parker graduated from Lankenau Motivation High School in 1989 and earned a B.A. from Bennett College in 1996.
Her career experience includes working as a legislative assistant to State Representative Rosita Youngblood and as director of media relations with Ross Associates, Inc.
Parker assumed office in the House on December 1, 2020, succeeding Rosita Youngblood.
